content.title: Confirm detection range, reaction latency, robot interface, and indoor safety constraints before component selection
content.description: Validate the obstacle detection range/field of view, maximum reaction latency, robot-controller interface semantics, and indoor safety/fail-safe assumptions so future embedded component selection remains grounded in confirmed needs.
content.rationale: The current functional architecture can represent unknown constraints as open questions, but selecting concrete obstacle sensing and reaction behaviors depends on confirmed range, timing, interface behavior, and indoor safety expectations.

completionCondition.completionCriteria: Confirm (1) obstacle detection range and field of view, (2) required maximum reaction latency, (3) robot-controller interface behavior semantics, and (4) indoor safety/fail-safe assumptions; then mark Q1-Q4 as answered/resolved and proceed to component selection in the next workflow.
